Host.AlreadyRunning: Hearthpulse is already running — look for it in the system tray.
Host.Busy.StartupProblem: Startup problem — see hearthpulse.log in the data folder.
Host.Busy.GameNotFound: Hearthstone not found. Set its folder in settings.json (HearthstonePath) if it is installed somewhere unusual.
Host.Busy.NothingToImport: Hearthstone install not found — nothing to import.
Host.Busy.Importing: Importing past games from Hearthstone logs…
Host.Busy.Imported: Imported {0} new games from {1} log sessions.
Host.Update.AvailableZip: {0} is out. Get the portable zip from the GitHub releases page.
Host.Update.AvailablePortable: {0} is out. Download the new portable version from GitHub.
Host.Update.AvailableAppImage: {0} is out. Download the new AppImage from GitHub.
Host.Update.Ready: {0} is downloaded — it installs when you close Hearthpulse.
Host.Update.DownloadFailed: Version {0} could not be downloaded; Hearthpulse tries again later.
Host.Notify.LogSettingsChanged: Hearthpulse changed the game's log settings. Restart Hearthstone once so tracking starts and lasts whole games.
Host.Notify.LoggingEnabled: Hearthpulse enabled the game's logging. Restart Hearthstone once so tracking can start.
Host.Notify.LogCapped: Hearthstone stopped writing its game log at its 10 MB limit, so tracking stopped. Hearthpulse removed the limit: restart Hearthstone to keep tracking.
Host.Notify.Refreshed: Re-read the current game from Hearthstone's log.
Host.Notify.SoftwareRendering: Software rendering is on; restart Hearthpulse to apply it.
Host.Notify.HardwareRendering: Hardware rendering is on; restart Hearthpulse to apply it.
Host.Notify.OverlayHidden: Press Ctrl+Shift+H to show it again.
Host.Crash.Title: Something went wrong
Host.Crash.FatalText: An unexpected error stopped Hearthpulse. It was written to the log.
Host.Crash.Text: Hearthpulse hit an unexpected error and keeps running. It was written to the log.
